classification.difficultyReason: Extend the explicitly scaffolded volume-divided-by-base-area method to triangular and circular bases, selecting relevant dimensions and converting litres to cubic centimetres.

children.prompt: A rectangular container is partially filled with 2.4 litres of water.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the base area of the container, in square cm.

spec.description: Open rectangular container, receding upwards to the right, with a wavy water surface and external dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal base 20 cm by 20 cm; full height 10 cm; water depth d. Model vertices are (0,0,0), (20,0,0), (20,20,0), (0,20,0) and their translates by (0,0,10). Viewing direction from the solid towards the viewer has signs (+,-,+). Front and right faces are visible; rear-bottom edges are dashed. Water height is schematic and is not a supplied numerical measurement.
spec.answerVisibility: Dimensions and unknown d only; no calculated area or depth.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the depth of the water using $V=Ah$, where the height is $d$.
Use the same method as the preceding parts to calculate the depth of water in these containers.

spec.description: Open rectangular container with water; dimensions 80 cm, 60 cm and full height 40 cm. Volume caption beneath.
spec.mathematics: Rectangular horizontal base 80 by 60 cm and vertical height 40 cm. Explicit front, right, rear, left and bottom faces; viewing direction towards viewer (+,-,+). Rear-bottom edges and rear-left upright are concealed. Drawn water level is schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: Volume 96 L and supplied dimensions only.

spec.description: Upright triangular container, with red perpendicular altitude on its upper horizontal triangular cross-section and water below.
spec.mathematics: True horizontal cross-section vertices A=(0,0), B=(40,0), C=(u,20), with u unspecified; perpendicular foot F=(u,0). Vertical prism height 30 cm. The illustrative projection places the rear apex above the front edge without asserting equal sides or angles. Faces: lower ABC, upper DEF, rectangles ABED, B C F E and C A D F. View from the front and above: ABED is the visible front face; lower rear edges and rear upright are dashed. Altitude is a separate construction line.
spec.answerVisibility: 40 cm base, 20 cm perpendicular altitude, 30 cm full height and Volume = 8 L only.

spec.description: Open upright cylinder with wavy water boundary, top centre and highlighted radius.
spec.mathematics: Radius 60 cm, full vertical height 150 cm. Viewed from above and in front; both vertical silhouettes stay solid, front bottom semicircle solid and rear bottom semicircle dashed. The top rim is fully visible. Water level is schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: 60 cm radius, 150 cm height and Volume = 500 L only.
